reason: Original V58 design defined d(v_i,v_j) without uniquely binding v and d
scope: Only retrieval representation, distance and mechanical calculation rules; all original V58 cases, orders, N/V assignments, formulas, test, threshold, stack and claim boundary remain unchanged

representation.name: Ordered Top-5 Retrieval Footprint
representation.text_field_rule: str(row.get('memory') or row.get('text') or row.get('data') or '')
representation.text_normalization: Unicode NFC; CRLF to LF; strip; collapse consecutive whitespace; preserve case, punctuation and duplicates
representation.embedding_failures: Non-finite, zero norm or wrong dimension is an execution error
representation.missing_positions: zero 384D embedding and zero presence mask
representation.present_mask: one at each present rank, weighted by rank weight

unchanged_primary.cell_dispersion: mean of the three pairwise distances among the three predecessor-labeled observations for each target-position-policy cell
unchanged_primary.policy_dispersion: mean of 12 target-position cell dispersions per policy
unchanged_primary.randomization: all 4096 within-order-block N/V label swaps; recompute all cells and effect for each assignment
unchanged_primary.claim_boundary: Fixed four-case panel policy effect on complete-history/order-conditioned retrieval dispersion only

rationale: No V58 formal outcome existed before this amendment
The V57 project prospectively froze the same Top-5 1925D footprint
V57 primary inference used Euclidean norm on that footprint
The approved V59 design says it continues using the same Top-5 footprint
Reuse narrows researcher degrees of freedom versus a newly selected distance
